content.short: Ask LibFi provides deFAI Trust Agent for portfolio management, strategy optimization, and conversational DeFi onboarding.
content.description: Ask LibFi by Liberty Finance is an AI assistant that makes DeFi accessible, efficient, and compliant. Powered by the DeFAI engine, it delivers portfolio insights, automated yield analysis, and real-time recommendations for staking, lending, and investing. It offers risk-adjusted strategies, liquidation-proof lending tools, and cross-chain portfolio optimization. With an ethics-minded, compliance-focused lens, Ask LibFi evaluates token suitability and reveals values-aligned halal yields.
